Hot chocolate milk with a shot of coffee and maple syrup, topped with whipped cream, mini marshmallows and crushed candy cane. Heat 800ml milk with 100g chopped milk chocolate and 3 tbsp maple syrup, whisking until smooth and steaming. Stir in 200ml strong coffee, or leave it out for the kids. Pour into 4 mugs, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream, a handful of mini marshmallows, a drizzle of maple syrup and crushed candy cane.

s.note: Crunchy popcorn clusters coated in maple syrup and butter.
s.how: Pop 60g popping corn in 1 tbsp vegetable oil. Boil 200ml maple syrup with 40g butter to 120C. Pour over the popcorn, toss quickly and spread on a lined tray to set for 30 minutes. Break into clusters.

s.note: White chocolate pretzel rods coated in crushed candy canes.
s.how: Melt 150g white chocolate in a bowl over barely simmering water. Dip 12 pretzel rods two-thirds into the chocolate, roll immediately in 60g crushed candy canes and set on baking paper for 30 minutes.

m.note: Griddled franks in steamed buns with tomato onions and sauerkraut.
m.how: Cook 2 sliced brown onions in 20g butter over medium-low heat for 20 minutes. Add 200g crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Simmer 4 large franks in water for 5 minutes, drain and griddle for 2 minutes a side. Warm 200g sauerkraut in a saucepan for 5 minutes and steam 4 buns for 1 minute. Assemble with 4 tbsp yellow mustard and the tomato onions.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes domed with cream cheese frosting and shredded coconut.
w.how: Heat the oven to 180C. Beat 80g soft butter with 80g caster sugar, add 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla, then fold in 100g self-raising flour and 40ml milk. Divide between 4 large cupcake cases and bake for 18 minutes. Cool completely. Beat 100g cream cheese with 20g butter and 100g icing sugar, dome over the cakes and roll in 40g shredded coconut.
